name: Garment dyeing
summary: A garment is dyed after it is sewn, in a drum. Cloth, thread and tape take one colour and each piece differs a little.
how: Sew the garment from undyed cloth and thread that takes dye.
Tumble the garment in a drum of dye and water.
Rinse, dry and finish the garment, and check the colour.

origin.note: Massimo Osti dyes made-up garments in a drum for his labels.

adoptions.via: Techwear labels dye the whole shell and trouser black, so that the cloth, the thread and the tape match.
